gloss: member of the Diet; member of parliament

definitions.gloss: member of the Diet; member of parliament
definitions.explanation: An elected member of Japan's national legislature ({国会|こっかい}). Includes both members of the House of Representatives ({衆議院|しゅうぎいん}) and the House of Councillors ({参議院|さんぎいん}).

examples.japanese: {国会議員|こっかいぎいん}に{立候補|りっこうほ}する。
examples.english: To run for a seat in the Diet.

examples.japanese: {国会議員|こっかいぎいん}の{定数|ていすう}は{衆参|しゅうさん}{合|あ}わせて{七百名以上|ななひゃくめいいじょう}いる。
examples.english: There are over 700 members of the Diet between the two houses combined.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{国会議員|こっかいぎいん}に{陳情|ちんじょう}するために{事務所|じむしょ}を{訪|たず}ねた。
examples.english: I visited the office to petition the local Diet member.

notes:
The standard term for members of Japan's national parliament ({国会|こっかい}). In news reports, often shortened to {議員|ぎいん} when the context is clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国会議員|こっかいぎいん}{選挙|せんきょ}: Diet member election
- {国会議員|こっかいぎいん}の{歳費|さいひ}: Diet member's salary
- {国会議員|こっかいぎいん}に{当選|とうせん}する: to be elected to the Diet
- {国会議員|こっかいぎいん}を{辞職|じしょく}する: to resign from the Diet

RELATED WORDS:
- {衆議院議員|しゅうぎいんぎいん}: member of the House of Representatives
- {参議院議員|さんぎいんぎいん}: member of the House of Councillors
- {地方議員|ちほうぎいん}: local assembly member
- {議員|ぎいん}: legislator, council member — the general term
